legend: (truck parking) 1 km ON LEFT / STOP REVIVE SURVIVE

sa_g7-sa128_symbol.desc: truck parking symbol S13 (P over a truck) at 260 %

notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. Sheet G7-SA128-2 (advance sign, 2400 x 1800 in the register): two boards in one assembly — the blue sign 2400 x 1200 (R150, blue edge 30 + white border 30, sheet 60 / 30) above the white slogan plate 2400 x 600 (R100, white edge 10 + blue border 20, sheet 30 / 10), drawn 50 apart as on the sheet (the gap is not dimensioned; measured), so the file is 2400 x 1850 with the gap transparent. Blue sign: truck parking symbol S13 (P over a truck) at 260 %, 910 high, 145 from top and bottom — traced from the sheet's filled artwork; 1 km (numerals 200 E, unit 170 E lower case), ON and LEFT 200 E, white. Slogan plate: STOP REVIVE / SURVIVE 160 E blue. Legend placed from the sheet's filled artwork measured at 1200 dpi (the sheet's chains were read for the series and heights): 1 200 E top 181 x 1522-1583; km 170 E top 211 x 1667-1964; ON 200 E top 502 x 1545-1920; LEFT 200 E top 821 x 1398-2086; STOP 160 E blue top 1351 x 435-1023; REVIVE 160 E blue top 1351 x 1144-1971; SURVIVE 160 E blue top 1591 x 699-1705. The sheet's lower blue plate with empty symbol boxes (supplementary services, where shown) is a template and is not drawn.
